run_sample_inference: run the sample.py script to infer hand poses from body keypoints using a pretrained checkpoint
run_model_evaluation: run the main function to evaluate a regressor_fcn_bn_32 model against test data and compute MSE error
run_pose_pipeline: run a specified pipeline like arm2wh to predict wrist and hand joint positions from body features
run_inference_with_images: run the sample script with the require_image flag to include image data alongside body keypoints
run_save_results: run the sample script to save predicted hand pose results to the base path directory with a tag
